reason: The 65SC12 side is right but the change does not assemble in two required flag sets. Opcodes are all real on the 65SC12 (CMP/EOR abs,Y, CPY #, BRA, TRB zp; encodings checked in the listing). Semantics hold: wa_rows_base_lo is only 0 or &80, so CMP gives the no-borrow carry and EOR gives the low byte; CPY #25 takes the same rows 25/26 as the old BCC row_25, and the CLC stub keeps C clear for row_25. Cycles, shipping layout (wa_off &49 and wa_y &57 are in zero page): on the common path the column part goes from 13 to 11 and the y part from 27 to 16, so 13 cycles less each call. The table is at &A0C0-&A0D8 and does not cross a page. wa_rows_guess moves to &A117-&A156, so it no longer crosses &A100 and calls with X>=11 save 1 more. The 34-byte growth adds page crossings on rare taken branches: BRA y_of_row on late_column's row-below path (&A107 to &A0B2), BRA row_25 and BRA y_known on the row-25 path, and in sky_put_on BCS one_part and the four BCS fall; BNE to_moved stops crossing. It also moves ck_index, straight_sprite_lo/hi and the straight sprites. passbench --detail on the two scratch builds (seed 1, passes 500-2000) has render going from 23432 to 23373 and logic from 9440 to 9442: net -57 a pass, matching the claim. REFUTED because the 34 extra bytes in bank 4 break the bank 4 ASSERT (src/main.6502:151) in builds that have less room. A DEBUG_FULLREDRAW=1 build (the oracle that worldrun --control, scrollleft and kcguard compare against) fails with 'bank 4 overruns the renderer's workspace by 27'. A SKY_HELI=0 build fails with 'by 25'. The unmodified source assembles both. The shipping build and the all-GAMEPLAY build assemble.
